finding: No explicit product retry for original recording withdrawal after a lost reply and process restart.
path: Lost reply retains CANCEL_PENDING and the exact original withdrawal request.
ChatPane offers Retry Send for every prepared recording draft.
sendRecordingDraft reuses the prepared event and requests bounded publication.
JournalGuardedCadenceHandoff.queue calls journal.prepare, which refuses CANCEL_PENDING.
CadenceRoomTransport invokes revoked cleanup only when its current publication guard is no longer allowed. A permitted Retry Send does not replay the retained withdrawal.
required_change: Explicit cancellation retry using the retained original node, lease, credential expiry and withdrawal request; no automatic Send, replacement upload or deadline extension.
